title: Lykaon resource report v1
description: One run's resource report, printed by `lykaon report <file>` or returned by `lykaon serve` (the serve result also adds jsonrpc/id). The document describes the run; the `report` command itself exits 0 when it can write the document.

schema.description: Format identifier. A new incompatible report shape gets a new identifier.

file.description: The source file that was run.

exit.description: Process exit code of the run: 0, the code from `Exit with N.`, or 1 for a failure.

exit_reason.description: Why the run ended. `compile` means the source never ran; `fuel` is the sentence budget, `time` is Limit time (T0612), `memory` is Limit memory (T0611), `permission` is a refused sandbox permission (T0622), `exit` is `Exit with N.`, `signal` is an unhandled can-fail end.

fuel.description: The sentence budget that was requested; 0 means unlimited.

fuel_used.description: Sentences attempted. Counted whether or not a budget was set; 0 when the source did not compile.

wall_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds for compile plus run, as measured by the reporting process.

output_bytes.description: Byte length of the program output (UTF-8).

peak_alloc_bytes.description: Peak live allocation during the run above the run's starting baseline, in bytes. Approximate: the counter is process-wide and other threads can allocate while a run is active.

input_bytes.description: Byte length of the standard input the run read (0 when none was given).

permissions_used.description: The permissions the run actually used: `file <path>`, `host <h>`, `env <NAME>`, `processes <count>`. Empty when no sandbox was active.
